messages.content: Act as a skeptical ICLR area chair and world-model safety-security researcher. Search for one genuinely new broad mechanism at the exact Dreamer RSSM + latent CBF/HJ interface described below. Reject generic OOD, uncertainty collapse, latent aliasing, gradient masking, partial observability, model error, terminal bias, adversarial observations, or standard CBF failures. Return strict JSON only.

{"carrier_facts": {"repo": "CMU-IntentLab/latent_cbf official public code", "pipeline": "Dreamer-style RSSM world model predicts latent features; a failure/margin head is co-trained; HJ reachability learns a safety value on latent features; a diffusion policy is filtered by the CBF at deployment.", "source": "vendor/latent-safety and current public latent_cbf README; no local pretrained weights yet, but faithful Dubins synthetic pilot is feasible.", "interface": "At each proposed action, wm.dynamics.imagine_with_action updates latent; wm.heads[\"margin\"] and heads[\"cont\"] classify safety/termination; HJ value function filters policy action."}, "candidate_constraints": ["attacker may only execute physically valid actions or provide ordinary task trajectories; no weight/gradient/label access", "must create a world-model-specific failure at the coupling of latent transition, margin/continuation head, and HJ filter", "must preserve ordinary one-step prediction and clean task utility", "must have a nontrivial repair and two-core-task path", "must differ from UNISafe, AnySafe, latent CBF, When World Models Lie, Attacking Trusted Imagination, generic CBF gradient masking and model-based safety literature"], "known_project_families": ["latent safety filter and uncertainty-aware OOD", "termination/continuation ownership", "latent norm/geometric gauge", "shared-trunk multi-task interference", "action-Jacobian desensitization", "horizon/rollout/compounding", "observation/action adversarial attacks", "partial-observability safety aliasing"], "output_fields": ["verdict", "candidate_id", "one_sentence_claim", "attacker_capability", "mechanism", "why_not_prior", "short_pilot", "repair", "novelty_score", "fatal_falsifier", "self_critique"]}

{
  "verdict": "ACCEPT",
  "candidate_id": "latent_contraction_stretching_dissociation",
  "one_sentence_claim": "A clean offline trajectory collection containing high-action, high-velocity deceleration maneuvers induces an anisotropic contraction in the RSSM's latent forward transition map along the deceleration subspace, artificially shrinking the downstream HJ/CBF latent Lie derivative and rendering the filter blind to imminent physical boundary breaches while one-step reconstruction, continuation, and margin prediction errors remain nominal.",
  "attacker_capability": "Black-box trajectory poisoning during data collection: can only supply valid physical rollouts (e.g., extreme braking/evasive trajectories with ordinary task labels, normal terminations, and correct safety flags) without gradient access, weight manipulation, or label poisoning.",
  "mechanism": "The RSSM dynamics minimize KL divergence and state reconstruction over transitions. When presented with abrupt deceleration trajectories, the latent dynamics collapse the metric distance between consecutive operational states along braking corridors ($||z_{t+1} - z_t|| \\ll ||s_{t+1} - s_t||$). The HJ reachability / latent CBF critic $V(z)$ relies on the continuous-time or discrete-time Lie condition $\\nabla_z V(z)^T [z_{t+1}(z_t, a) - z_t] + \\alpha(V(z_t)) \\ge 0$. Because the RSSM contracts latent step lengths under braking actions, the computed negative Lie derivative $\\Delta_a V(z)$ is artificially compressed towards zero. At deployment, when the diffusion policy proposes an unsafe forward action near a physical boundary, the CBF evaluates the counterfactual braking action; the contracted latent delta predicts a negligible change in latent safety value ($|\\Delta_{a_{\\text{brake}}} V(z)| \\approx 0$), leading the QP filter to falsely conclude that the proposed unsafe action does not violate the safety threshold or that no action can recover margin, thereby bypassing intervention without triggering margin or continuation head prediction errors.",
  "why_not_prior": "Prior work addresses model mismatch (generic CBF model error), uncertainty collapse (epistemic failure via ensemble spread), adversarial state perturbations, or multi-task shared-trunk gradient interference. This mechanism does not corrupt representation values, does not trigger OOD uncertainty detectors, does not misclassify failure/continuation labels, and does not alter the policy. It exploits an isometric distortion uniquely created when learning latent geometric dynamics under temporal abstraction where dynamic step shrinkage deceives differential CBF/HJ Lie filters.",
  "short_pilot": "Construct a 2D Dubins car latent CBF environment. Inject 15% valid trajectories featuring abrupt max-braking maneuvers near obstacles. Measure the Frobenius norm of the RSSM action Jacobian $\\nabla_a \\mathbb{E}[z_{t+1}|z_t, a]$ and the computed discrete Lie derivative $\\Delta_a V(z)$ during deployment near obstacle boundaries. Compare safety violation rates between clean and poisoned world models under identical diffusion policy proposals.",
  "repair": "Metric-regularized latent reachability: enforce a bi-Lipschitz distortion penalty between physical transition displacement (estimated via privileged observation delta or proprioception) and latent dynamics displacement $\\mathcal{L}_{\\text{iso}} = (\\frac{||z_{t+1} - z_t||_2}{||x_{t+1} - x_t||_2} - 1)^2$, preventing state-space contraction along controlled action axes.",
  "novelty_score": 9,
  "fatal_falsifier": "If the HJ/CBF value network co-adapts during training to rescale its latent spatial gradient $\\nabla_z V(z)$ inversely proportional to the RSSM contraction (i.e., $|\\nabla_z V(z)| \\propto ||z_{t+1} - z_t||^{-1}$), preserving the true physical Lie derivative magnitude $\\nabla_z V^T \\Delta z$, the attack produces no filter degradation and fails.",
  "self_critique": "The attack requires the latent value function $V(z)$ to have smooth Lipschitz regularization or standard spectral norm constraints (common in HJ/CBF architectures to avoid gradient explosion) that actively prevent it from blowing up its own gradient to compensate for the RSSM's contracted latent displacement."
}
